coordinate_system.origin: front-left corner of finished bench footprint
coordinate_system.x_axis: left to right along the 90 in wall
coordinate_system.y_axis: front/infeed to rear/outfeed across the 48 in depth

seams.name: left_to_center_top_seam
seams.notes: Land this seam on the doubled wall between the left carriage module and the saw chassis. The left miter-track extension lands on this seam, so the joint must be glued flush and routed with a sacrificial backer.

seams.name: center_to_right_top_seam
seams.notes: Land this seam on the doubled wall between the saw chassis and the right service module.

modules.name: left_carriage_support
modules.notes: Open mechanism bay first. Do not lock the partition or shallow-storage parts until the support drawer and carriage runner geometry are proven.

support_drawer_bay.runner_type: shop-made hardwood or UHMW runners on fixed cleats

deferred_storage_bay.notes: LM-02 and LM-06 stay deferred until the drawer and carriage path are proven.

modules.name: saw_chassis
modules.notes: Open frame for saw cradle, dust elbow movement, and wrench access

modules.name: right_service
modules.notes: Router above, Hercules plus Low-Pro dust package below, no full-height divider may intrude into the rail keep-clear lanes

front_service_face.notes: RM-06 is the plain removable dust-service face.

control_subpanel.notes: RM-10 is a separate removable control subpanel that must come off or disconnect before RM-06.

saw.geometry_status: Blade Y datum, rail envelope, and baseline dust-reference measurements have been updated from stripped-saw measurements; mount-hole transfer drilling and final dust-branch hole placement still remain field-fit work.

blade_center.source: derived from measured stripped blade y plus the current cast-top placement
blade_center.precision_cut_gate: top-machining gate uses the measured blade y datum; mount-hole drilling and dust-branch routing remain separate field-fit steps

rail_envelope.notes: Measured planning envelope uses about 7 in left projection at minimum rip, about 18-5/8 in right projection at maximum rip, about 2-1/2 in front overhang, and about 1-5/8 in rear overhang.

opening.notes: Final opening is field-fit only after the blade y datum and rail envelope are confirmed on the real saw. The cradle deck can be transfer-drilled from the saw after flush tuning, so exact foot-center mapping is no longer treated as a top-machining prerequisite.

under_top_keep_clear.name: front_left_rail_lane
under_top_keep_clear.notes: Keep shallow storage, drawer framing, and guide hardware out of the front left rail pocket.

under_top_keep_clear.name: front_right_rail_lane
under_top_keep_clear.notes: No divider, wiring chase, or hose bracket may intrude into this lane above the plinth.

under_top_keep_clear.name: rear_left_rail_lane
under_top_keep_clear.notes: Keep shallow storage, drawer framing, and guide hardware out of the rear left rail pocket.

under_top_keep_clear.name: rear_right_rail_lane
under_top_keep_clear.notes: No divider, wiring chase, or hose bracket may intrude into this lane above the plinth.

travel_limits.notes: This branch now models honest literal translation inside the 48 in core rather than pretending to offer industrial sliding-table travel.

construction.runners: top-mounted guide strips plus adjustable UHMW wear pads or equivalent low-play hardware
construction.notes: Guide strips stay top-mounted and runner backers must bridge over the left rail pockets rather than hanging into them. Do not freeze the runner hardware until the saw survey and fixed-top dry-fit are complete.

fence.extension_capability: removable or flip-over extension for wider panels
fence.mounting: front and rear T-track or extrusion anchored to the carriage body
fence.square_adjustment: one end fixed and the other end micro-adjustable with a push-screw or slotted-bolt correction

support_drawer.runner_type: shop-made hardwood or UHMW runners on fixed cleats
support_drawer.load_role: near-front anti-droop support, not the primary squareness datum
support_drawer.notes: Acts as the no-overhang front support for deeper cuts and stores flush when not in use.

support.type: continuous hinge plus paired locking legs and hard stops
support.registration: mechanical stops at the bench side

left_support_table.notes: Supports the carriage only when needed for larger panels; it must not increase the parked footprint when folded. Hard stops still define position, but the paired legs are required to resist twist at the outer corners.

fence_mount_zone.notes: Reserved for removable fence hardware and dust pickup

access_hatch.notes: Provides reach to the router collet, lift hardware, and cabinet dust branch without removing the dust package.

packages.name: hercules_extractor_rear
packages.mount: fixed low deck or UHMW skid base

dust_bay.notes: This bay is intentionally modeled around the Hercules HE028 on a fixed low deck or UHMW skid base plus a Oneida Dust Deputy Low-Pro on a 5 gallon bucket. Service access is from the front, not from a large static rear void.

manifold.plumbing_sequence: tools to manifold, manifold to Low-Pro inlet, Low-Pro outlet to Hercules vacuum port

saw_branch.hatch_dependency: Rough dust-port center and hose-sweep measurements are now captured, but final routing holes still wait until the actual hose stack and cradle fit are marked in place.
saw_branch.parked_mode_note: The hose should drop into the open well immediately or the bench should park off the wall with a small spacer so the rear hose loop is never crushed.

router_branch.split_strategy: local Y-split inside router cavity for fence pickup plus cabinet pickup

tool_circuit.notes: Saw and router are never intended to run simultaneously on this branch.

control_strategy.extractor_start: RF remote or similar because split circuits disable current-sensing auto-start

garage_prerequisites: Two real garage circuits if simultaneous saw plus dust use is expected
GFCI-protected garage receptacles or equivalent code-compliant protection
Cord routing and strain relief that works in parked and rolled-out positions

registration.notes: Install only after the carriage is removed or parked out of the way.

underside_stiffener.location: Runs under the overlay where it spans the saw opening.
